title: PCBL Chemical Ltd. (NSE: PCBL) — Company Dossier
sector: Process Industries / Carbon Black & Specialty Chemicals
primer: PCBL Chemical is India's largest carbon black maker, with a specialty-chemicals arm, captive power and 900 ktpa of capacity [18][3]. The price-blind business verdict is CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL: record FY2026 volumes and clean audits, but returns near 8% and net debt near four times EBITDA [3]. New capital is REJECTED at the 13 November 2026 close of ₹282.55, because our probability-weighted two-year value is about ₹278 and the stock is in a broken trend [87][88]. A watch zone of ₹205–225 with a cancel level at ₹190 is a re-underwrite trigger, not an order. PCBL is not held, so the holding action is NOT_HELD and the next marginal cash unit stays in cash; status PUBLISHED_WITH_GATE_EXCEPTIONS.
holding_rationale: The same-session positions ledger shows no PCBL shares in any account, so there is nothing to hold, trim or exit and no stop to set. The REJECTED verdict applies only to new capital: at ₹282.55 the price already equals our base case (₹281), the probability-weighted value is about ₹278, and the trend is broken. The valuation watch zone of ₹205–225 is a re-underwrite level, not an order.

holding_alerts.trigger: Two consecutive weekly closes above the 30-week average (about ₹306) and the 200-day average (about ₹299.5) on volume above the 30-day average, with the 30-week average still rising
holding_alerts.instruction: Re-underwrite the technical gate and the valuation; no automatic purchase and no shares are held.

holding_alerts.trigger: Q3 FY2027 results show carbon black EBITDA per tonne ex one-offs of at least ₹17,000 on at least 150,000 tonnes, Aquapharm EBITDA of at least ₹55 Cr and total debt below 4 times LTM company EBITDA (4.15x at September 2026, CARE's own trigger basis)
holding_alerts.instruction: Re-run the business-quality audit and reverse DCF; results date not yet announced (expected late January to February 2027).

holding_alerts.trigger: Close inside the valuation watch zone ₹205–225 with weekly closes still above ₹190
holding_alerts.instruction: Re-underwrite for a staged entry only: at ₹225 the probability-weighted ₹278 would offer about 23% over two years and at ₹205 about 35%.

holding_alerts.trigger: Weekly close below ₹190, a rating downgrade below AA, or a debt-funded dividend or capex announcement
holding_alerts.instruction: Cancel the watch and stay in cash until a new base and fresh evidence form.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal cash unit; PCBL is not held, no sale proceeds are freed and nothing is allocated to PCBL.

destinations.recommendation: Retain the entire next marginal unit in cash.
destinations.rationale: PCBL is rejected, so there is no PCBL allocation to fund. Cash preserves optionality while the screened alternatives either belong to their own dossiers or fail the evidence and entry tests.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy only when an equity candidate clears current evidence, technical and reward-to-risk gates in its own underwriting.

destinations.recommendation: No allocation from this dossier; AJMERA is the nearest clear alternative and follows its own dossier.
destinations.rationale: AJMERA shows a Stage 2 scan (the market ledger reads Stage 3) with gate CLEAR_FOR_CONSIDERATION. The live scan band is ₹124.51–132.17 with a ₹119.98 stop, and the shortlist card band is ₹124.62–132.23 with a ₹120.00 stop and a ₹195.00 base target (5.13:1 from the top of the card band). The live close of ₹133.28 sits just above both bands. Its business was not re-underwritten here.
destinations.entry_condition: Act only on AJMERA's own dossier levels (band ₹124.62–132.23, stop ₹120.00); other clear scans today (COFORGE, APLAPOLLO, YASHHV, ZYDUSLIFE, MANORAMA) are likewise governed by their own cards.

destinations.rationale: Peers screened in this review do not clear the bar: HSCL is a 22% ROCE carbon-materials business but trades at 27.2 times EV/EBITDA in Stage 4; SRF is Stage 4; AARTIIND is Stage 2 but earns a 6.9% ROCE at 15.6 times; DEEPAKNTR is Stage 4. None was fully underwritten for a funded position.
destinations.entry_condition: Fund an outside name only after a separate evidence-backed review shows current entry asymmetry.

horizons.rationale: Stage 4 per the scanner, below the 30-week and 50-day averages, lagging the Nifty by 14.8 points over 63 days, no confirmed four-hour turn.
Carbon black EBITDA per tonne is recovering but is flattered by spot gains and a tariff refund; Aquapharm and deleveraging need proof.
Returns on capital near 8% are below an assumed 10% hurdle and free cash has not turned reliably positive without working-capital releases.

gate_exceptions: No live TradingView Chrome tab was open when the options script ran, so the 1W, 1D and 4H read uses the same-session TradingView feed rather than a chart inspection [87].

The market ledger carries the 12 November bar for PCBL (close ₹285.45) and flags most stocks stale against 13 November. The official 13 November close of ₹282.55 comes from TradingView. The ledger calls the stock Stage 1 (Basing) while the scanner calls it Stage 4. We adopt the stricter scanner reading and show the conflict in Chapter 8 [87][89].

The citation check runs with the stale-as-of allowance and lists 690 of 777 research records as more than 60 days older than the 13 November 2026 report date. Every as_of date is true and none was edited. Most records describe a dated filing, call or event, so their age is part of the evidence. The bands below give the record count, the age, what the records are and the cure.

Band A, 73 days, 26 records, as_of September 2026: Q2 FY2027 results, balance sheet, volumes and capacity (for example the Q2 FY2027 income statement, borrowings, inventories and cash). Cure: the Q3 FY2027 results, expected late January to February 2027.

Band B, 107 to 136 days, 59 records, as_of June to July 2026: Q1 FY2027 results, call statements and the Q1 inventory gain and tariff refund estimates. Cure: Q3 FY2027 results; where Q2 repeats a metric the Q2 figure is used.

Band C, 153 to 257 days, 280 records, as_of March to June 2026: the FY2026 audited statements in the Integrated Report, the Q4 FY2026 call and the CARE, ICRA and CRISIL rating actions. Cure: the FY2027 annual report, expected around August 2027, and the next rating reviews.

Band D, 283 to 438 days, 96 records, as_of September 2025 to February 2026: Q2 and Q3 FY2026 calls and releases, including the December 2025 labour-code charge. These are the historical record for the management audit. Cure: not applicable.

Band E, 469 to 987 days, 113 records, as_of 2024 to 2025: FY2024 and FY2025 filings and calls, the acquisition deck and earlier guidance. They are the promises that Chapter 5 tests against delivery. Cure: not applicable.

Band F, more than 1,000 days, 116 records, as_of 1960 to 2024: company history, 2019 to 2023 guidance, the 2020 to 2021 anti-dumping record and peer filings. They are cited as history with their dates and cannot be refreshed. Cure: not applicable.

Some facts could not be sourced: the CRISIL rating rationale, a primary source for the promoter pledge, management's reason for the September 2026 inventory and payables build, and any government notification of the Aquapharm phosphonate duty. The chapters say not published instead of estimating.

Both review passes ran on the runner's default agent, not on the configured model names. Round 1 returned BLOCK (reviewer) and verdict holds (red team). Round 2 returned APPROVE with four notes. Two of those notes were fixed in wording after round 2: the market-cap cause and the ROE figure. No third review was run.
